note: Canonical league names — the name Tony uses when he speaks to somebody.
This file is the authority for `users.display_name`. Sleeper seeds nothing here:
a Sleeper handle is provenance (`users.sleeper_username`), the Sleeper user ID is
the durable external key (`users.sleeper_user_id`), and the canonical name is a
league decision recorded here. Changing a name is an edit to this file plus a
re-import, which makes every change reviewable in git and auditable in sync_runs.
`source` records who approved each mapping. Do not add an entry without one.
An account with no entry keeps its Sleeper display name and is reported at import,
so an unmapped person is visible rather than silently wrong.
RETIREMENT IS NOT DELETION. A retired manager keeps every membership, team name,
record, finish, and co-owner relationship. `users.is_retired` hides nobody from
history; it records that they are not playing now. History may name them freely
when discussing the seasons they played.
